verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of natural-language operation is Azure Copilot generating Terraform configurations, a narrow AI-assisted task that implies a natural-language interface but does not document general resource operation by command. The MCP server probe concerns exposing Azure to external agents, which is a separate capability and is not credited here. missing for 10: documentation that natural-language commands can operate Azure resources broadly (create, modify, query, delete), explicit description of the Copilot natural-language interface and its scope, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Generate Terraform configurations using Azure Copilot
